answer: Here is one mechanism that works: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because zephyr only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, tundra is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any prism approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
